name: W&J Perms PA 2026
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Information tab.

W&J students may compete in this competition for free. After you register and pay as normal, leave a comment with your student id, or email the organizers with your student id, and we will issue you a refund.
